hero.title: Smarter, safer, faster work with AI and AR–guided work instructions
hero.subtitle:
ActARion helps industrial, logistics and energy companies capture critical know-how, guide operators in the flow of work and build a learning organization across sites. We transform SOPs and manuals into AI and AR–guided digital work instructions. Operators see step-by-step AR SOPs on tablets or smart glasses, so they can work safer, faster and with fewer errors.

As the European partner of Deep Sight, we bring an AR-first connected worker platform to the shop floor.

whatWeDo.title: Why the way we work has to change
whatWeDo.description: The future of work did not start with AI. Every wave of technology has changed how we produce, collaborate and learn, from the assembly line to robotics and software. In this reality, simply adding more training hours or more PDFs is not enough.

about.title: About ActARion
about.subtitle: Why we exist
about.description:
Work in operations is changing quickly. Processes are more complex, safety and compliance standards are stricter, and experienced technicians are harder to find. Yet many teams still depend on PDFs, classroom training and informal shadowing to get work done.

ActARion exists to help industrial, logistics and energy companies respond to that reality by enabling people to work smarter, faster and safer with the support of AR and AI.

We focus on the last step of knowledge transfer: how instructions, procedures and expertise actually reach the technician, operator or field engineer at the moment of work.

How we help:
• Deep Sight AR platform — We work with Deep Sight , an AR‑first connected worker platform, to turn procedures and expert knowledge into interactive work instructions and SOPs.
• From expert know‑how to clear guidance — We help capture expertise from senior technicians and translate it into clear, visual guidance that less experienced colleagues can follow with confidence.
• From pilots to scale — We support your teams in identifying use cases, running focused pilots and scaling what works across lines, plants and countries.

ActARion combines world‑class AR technology with local, hands‑on support. Our focus is always the same: closing the gap between procedure and actual performance.
about.missionText:
• SOPs are more than documents — Standard Operating Procedures are the backbone of quality, safety and performance. They only create value when they are easy to find, easy to follow and easy to improve.
• Knowledge should live where the work happens — People should not have to leave their task or search multiple systems while a line is down. Guidance needs to be available in context, step by step, in the actual environment.
• Technology should make work clearer — AR and AI are useful only if they reduce ambiguity, make tasks easier to understand and give teams more confidence in what they do.
• Continuous improvement is a daily routine — Every task is a learning moment. Execution data should flow back into better instructions, better training and better processes.
about.partnersText:
Our customers are organizations in industry, logistics, utilities and energy that see operations as their main differentiator. Typical stakeholders we work with include:
• Operations and plant managers who want consistent performance across sites
• Maintenance and reliability teams that have to protect uptime with fewer experts
• HSE and quality managers responsible for safe, compliant work every day
• HR and L&D teams who must onboard new colleagues faster without overloading senior staff
• Digital, IT and innovation teams looking for practical AR/AI use cases with measurable impact
For these teams, “smarter, faster, safer work” is not a slogan. It is a condition for staying competitive, meeting regulation and keeping people engaged.

Smarter — Operational knowledge is structured, searchable and available across locations. Lessons learned in one site can be reused everywhere.
Faster — Onboarding and training times go down, changeovers become repeatable, and troubleshooting is supported by remote experts when needed.
Safer — Visual, step‑by‑step guidance and built‑in checks reduce variance, incidents and compliance risk. Safety requirements are part of the normal flow of work, not a separate checklist.

Let’s explore whether this is relevant for you. If you are responsible for operations, maintenance, HSE, quality, HR/L&D or digital innovation, and you recognize the pressure to:
• do more with fewer experienced people
• secure knowledge before it leaves the organization
• improve productivity while staying safe and compliant
then it may be worth exploring what AR and AI can do in your environment.

ActARion is led by Managing Partners Mark Dercksen and Ortwin Verreck, supported by a network of AR, AI and operations specialists.

We are happy to start with a short discovery session or future of work briefing tailored to your teams and use cases.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ActARion

questions.q: What is ActARion?
questions.a: ActARion is an augmented reality (AR) platform that transforms traditional Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) into visual, interactive workflows. It enables teams to deliver on-the-job training, real-time guidance, and knowledge capture at scale—across mobile devices and smart glasses.

questions.q: Who is ActARion for?
questions.a: ActARion is built for industrial companies—manufacturers, field service providers, logistics firms, and utilities—looking to improve efficiency, safety, and quality at the frontline.

questions.q: What makes ActARion different?
questions.a: Unlike text-heavy SOPs or disconnected training systems, ActARion offers: No-code creation of 3D and AR work instructions, Cross-device deployment on mobile, tablet, and smart glasses, Integrated remote support and feedback loops, Centralized knowledge management for teams and shifts.

questions.q: Which hardware is compatible with ActARion?
questions.a: ActARion supports: Smart glasses: Microsoft HoloLens 2, Apple Vision Pro, Smartphones and tablets: iOS and Android, Rugged devices for industrial use.

questions.q: Do you supply hardware?
questions.a: We do not resell hardware but work with certified partners to recommend and bundle supported devices tailored to your operational environment.

questions.q: Can ActARion integrate with our existing systems?
questions.a: Yes. We offer API support and custom integration services for: ERP (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365), MES systems, Learning Management Systems (LMS), HR and quality systems.

questions.q: What data can be collected and analyzed?
questions.a: Our platform captures: Time-on-task and step duration, Multiple-choice responses, User-generated photos and videos, Digital checklists and numeric entries.

questions.q: Is integration included by default?
questions.a: Basic APIs are included. More complex integrations may require implementation support or customization services.

questions.q: What does implementation look like?
questions.a: A typical rollout takes 2–6 months, depending on your goals. Each client receives a dedicated account manager to oversee onboarding and deployment.

questions.q: Do you work with implementation partners?
questions.a: Yes. We collaborate with system integrators, training consultants, and solution providers across Europe.

questions.q: I'm interested in becoming a partner. What's the process?
questions.a: Reach out to learn more about the ActARion Partner Program, which includes training, co-selling, and integration support for resellers and service providers.

questions.q: What kind of support is offered after launch?
questions.a: We provide: Helpdesk support with SLA options, Feature updates every 3 weeks, Customer success reviews and feedback cycles.

questions.q: What's the added value of ActARion?
questions.a: ActARion helps your business: Accelerate onboarding by 50–75%, Reduce operational errors by over 80%, Capture expert knowledge visually, Enable self-guided execution on the floor, Improve compliance and certification tracking.

questions.q: How can I build a business case for ActARion?
questions.a: Evaluate impact in areas like: Time to onboard (4-6 weeks → 1-2 weeks), SOP error rate (10-15% → <2%), Monthly downtime per team (8-10 hours → <2 hours), Training cost per employee (€1,000–€2,000 → up to 50% savings), Expert dependency (High → Reduced).

questions.q: What ROI can I expect?
questions.a: Most clients achieve ROI within 6–12 months through: Increased productivity, Fewer support escalations, Shorter time-to-competence, Improved quality and safety metrics.

questions.q: How does ActARion address workforce turnover and aging?
questions.a: We help organizations retain critical knowledge digitally and make it available to new employees instantly—closing the experience gap and minimizing operational risk.

questions.q: Do I need coding experience to use ActARion?
questions.a: Not at all. Our no-code web authoring tool lets trainers and subject-matter experts build and deploy interactive AR instructions quickly.

questions.q: Can I use ActARion for compliance training?
questions.a: Yes. You can define certification paths, track user progress, and log assessments for compliance and audits.

questions.q: Is the platform multilingual?
questions.a: Yes, we support content creation and delivery in multiple languages—ideal for international and multicultural teams.

questions.q: Does ActARion support remote assistance?
questions.a: Yes. Experts can assist frontline workers in real-time via live video and AR overlays for troubleshooting and mentoring.
